item.title: Sean Daly receives EFL Special Recognition Award
item.description: Millwall Community Trust (MCT) CEO Sean Daly has received a special recognition award from the EFL for his outstanding 26 years of service. Daly received the award at an EFL conference in Birmingham last week before Director of Community at the EFL, Debbie Cook, presented the award pitchside prior to The Lions' victory over Derby County on Tuesday night. Sean joined Millwall Community Trust in March 2018 after spending 18 years as the Head of Football and Sports Development at Charlton Athletic

item.description: MAKE A PLEDGE!Millwall Football Club is joining clubs around the country to take part in Green Football - a campaign bringing fans, clubs and players together to protect the game we love and the nature we share. item.title: MCT host 2026 Mizen Cup
item.description: Millwall Community Trust hosted the annual - and another successful - Jimmy Mizen Cup tournament (sponsored by Wiggett Group) on Thursday morning. item.title: Karen Wilson reaches 30 years of service at Millwall
item.description: Millwall Football Club would like to express its gratitude to Karen Wilson, who reached 30 years of service with The Lions on Tuesday. Prior to the win over Derby County, Karen, Head of Training Ground Operations, was greeted out of the tunnel by a guard of honour from fellow staff members - including Lions Chairman, James Berylson - and was gifted a bouquet of flowers. item.title: Femi Azeez wins EFL Sky Bet Championship Player of the Month award
item.description: Millwall Football Club is delighted to confirm that Femi Azeez has been named as the EFL Sky Bet Championship Player of the Month for February 2026. Contributing towards five Millwall goals in addition to his Goal of the Season contender against Birmingham City, Azeez was in red-hot form and, as a result, fought off competition from three other players to claim the award.
